purpose: A reproducible single-target interactive simulator probe for Fury mechanics and bounded search. It is not the character's current in-game equipment and is not evidence of policy superiority.

weapon_override.scope: The weapon pair has no weapon enchant and no item-level triggered proc. This does not claim that talents or non-weapon equipment contain no effects.

excluded_weapon.name: Bonereaver's Edge
excluded_weapon.reason: Its triggered armor-reduction effect changes the target-armor state and would confound the first queue, swing-timer, rage, and short-horizon search probe.

simulator_blockers: The current white-swing rage formula failed its external holdout and is not globally calibrated.
Dual-wield miss penalty and queued-next-swing effects on off-hand outcomes are not live identified.
Multi-target eligibility, Whirlwind range, incoming rage, genuine target-switch queue behavior, extra attacks, parry haste, and non-Flurry haste transitions remain incomplete.
Most item, set-bonus, raid-buff, and encounter-specific effects are not covered by one complete live contract.
Cat, Cat2, and Contra do not yet provide non-empty same-state callable expert traces for this profile.
